entries.title: Apple reintroduces the AI-powered Siri it announced at WWDC 2024
entries.summary: At WWDC 2026, Apple resurrected its AI-powered voice assistant, now named Siri AI.
entries.excerpt: After going MIA for two years, Apple's redesigned Siri has finally resurfaced. At WWDC 2026, the company showed off a new version of the AI-powered Siri we first saw in 2024, now called Siri AI. As announced at the start of the year, Apple haspartnered with Googleto rebuild Apple Intelligence and Siri on top of its rival's Gemini models.

entries.title: Everything announced at Apple's WWDC 2026 keynote
entries.summary: Here's everything announced at Apple's WWDC 2026 keynote.
entries.excerpt: Ahead of WWDC, it was widely expected that Apple would place a heavy emphasis on its (delayed) overhaul of Siri, which it first demoed at the2024 edition of the event. The company confirmed back in January that a "more personalized Siri" was coming this year, and that it would bepowered by Google's Gemini models. This updated version of the assistant is called Siri AI.
